old_string: return listed(L.Tops, Top) or listed(L.FemaleTops, Top) or (L.Civ ~= nil and (listed(L.Civ.Tops, Top) or listed(L.Civ.FemaleTops, Top)))
new_string: return listed(L.Tops, Top) or listed(L.FemaleMatchTops, Top) or (L.Civ ~= nil and listed(L.Civ.Tops, Top))

old_string:
-- the girls' versions of each clique's school top
local FemaleTops = {

for Id, Tops in FemaleTops do
	local Look = Cliques.Defs[Id] and Cliques.Defs[Id].Look
	if Look then Look.FemaleTops = Tops end
end
new_string:
for Id, Tops in FemaleMatchTops do
